Priya (partnerships): Heads up — we just saw a spike in alerts. Marketplace CSV shows entitlements burning on local-day boundaries (PST) while our usage window is UTC. ~200 customers hit limits around midnight. Any quick fixes?
Alex (eng): Yikes. Which marketplace? Azure or someone else?
Priya (partnerships): Azure marketplace. Their metering export has a `reported_day` that appears to be the customer's local day, not UTC.
Marco (eng-infra): This is the timezone-on-creation edge case we flagged months ago for SI integrations. We persist usage as UTC timestamps; reconciliation buckets by day -> mismatch at boundaries adds/loses tokens.
Jamie (finance): We're getting refund/credit requests. Affected SKUs: REDWOOD-PRO-1, PRO-BURST. Need a short-term mitigation.
Priya (partnerships): Sample from marketplace CSV (truncated):
```
customer_id,reported_day,usage_units,sku,region
CUST-9843,2026-03-19,120,REDWOOD-PRO-1,us-west-2
CUST-9843,2026-03-20,30,REDWOOD-PRO-1,us-west-2
```
Alex (eng): We can patch the reconciliation lambda to normalize `reported_day` -> convert to UTC-day using a timezone mapping for the customer before bucketization. Quick delta: add `billing_timezone` lookup step. I can draft PR.
Marco (eng-infra): Do we have `billing_timezone` anywhere? The marketplace payload doesn't include it; only region and address (country/state).
Priya (partnerships): Confirmed: marketplace webhook/export has no timezone field. We only get region and billing_address country/state. Deriving TZ from country is noisy (e.g., US has many TZs).
Alex (eng): Workaround for today: backfill script that shifts rows by plausible offsets for known west-coast customers (-8/-7), but that's ad-hoc. Better: reconciliation override table for a short window where we force UTC alignment for impacted customers. Less risky than mass backfill.
Jamie (finance): For customer-facing: we need an "under review" invoice flag and a credit memo template. I'll prepare communications for impacted customers and ops to approve credits.
OpsBot (bot): creating ticket PRT-2023: "marketplace-timezone-recon" with label billing-recon and priority P1.
Priya (partnerships): Action items: Alex open PR for normalization + unit tests; Marco add ingestion transform to detect and tag suspicious local-day skew; Jamie prepare credit memo + list of impacted customers; I'll draft customer note and own comms.
Alex (eng): PR branch name: `fix/az-marketplace-tz-normalize`. I'll add unit tests and a small migration for the override table. ETA EOD today.
Marco (eng-infra): I'll add a feature flag `marketplace_tz_normalize` so we can rollout config-side first. Also will add a reconciliation log entry for every adjusted row.
Jamie (finance): Share impacted customer list with billing@redwood and legal for approval before any credits.
Priya (partnerships): Thanks. After the patch we should run a dry-run reconcile for last 7 days and check delta counts. If net-change > 1% for a customer -> manual review.
Alex (eng): Also adding small snippet to codebase for conversion so we have a canonical approach: 
```
# convert reported_day (local) to UTC-day based on tz
from dateutil import tz, parser
local = parser.parse(reported_day + 'T00:00:00')
customer_tz = tz.gettz(customer_tz_str)
utc_day = local.replace(tzinfo=customer_tz).astimezone(tz.UTC).date()
```
Priya (partnerships): OK. I'll post a short note to the Azure contacts asking if they can include timezone in future exports (or a UTC timestamp). Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
Alex (eng): On it.
Marco (eng-infra): I'll coordinate with ops for running the dry-run and provide logs.
Jamie (finance): Standby for the list.
Priya (partnerships): closing the loop here — thanks everyone.
